_about: 0.3.5 (6 Nov 2026), the owner on the pad card: prompts do not disappear in windows and modals. Contextual now fades only outside them.

prompt_bar.help: The bottom-right row of button prompts on controller screens. Contextual: on every window, menu and modal for as long as it is open, and in a base room when it is new to you or a decision is pending; Always: in the rooms too.
